newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES EASE TO CLOSE AT 22.50 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES EASE TO CLOSE AT 22.50 PCT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed a shade weaker, at 22.50 percent compared with Thursday's close at 22.625 percent in calm trade, dealers said.

Banks have apparently well filled their reserves, leaving demand modest today, traders said, adding they did not expect the market's overall pattern to change substantially on Monday, which is the last session of banks' two-week reserve period.
"No major movements can be expected (for Monday), with the current interest rate levels remaining," said Judit Kecskes of OTP Bank.
